acceptanceCriteria: Each loop-variant case in the harness asserts the specific refusal reason it was designed to provoke, and a control whose refusal is indistinguishable from the others is recorded as not discriminating.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent review of PR #87 (V1-0012 daily-loop measurement, run-001). harness.py:436-443 treats every loop-variant refusal as `dogfood-report-drift`; the L3c control therefore cannot fail separately and adds no evidence.
title: daily-loop bench: loop-variant refusals are all the generic `dogfood-report-drift`, so the L3c control is a no-op
